Offering a location 450 m from the Lake of the Restored Sword, this 4-star hotel overlooks lake and has an American restaurant. The hotel places you about 20 minutes' walk from the hexagonal Flag Tower of Hanoi and 2.5 km from the President Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. Places of worship to visit not far from the Old Quarter Hotel & Travel Hanoi include the majestic church "Saint Joseph Cathedral". Guests can easily get in touch with the history of Hanoi by visiting the yellow beaux-arts Presidential Palace, located 2.8 km from the property. This Hanoi hotel is in proximity to Ha Noi railway station. Hanoi Old Quarter Hotel & Travel has 17 rooms appointed with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, as well as self-catering options such as a minibar fridge. For your comfort, you will find here an electric kettle and glassware. Along with a bidet, a separate toilet, and a sink, bathroom comforts also include a hairdryer and bathrobes. An American breakfast is offered on-site. The restaurant menu features African dishes. Guests may find the restaurant Cau Go Vietnamese Cuisine Restaurant within 5 minutes' walk of the Old Quarter Hotel & Travel.
